justification: New display-only component, reason-text map, suburb parser and export script. Nothing is wired into a route yet, so no served answer changes; the data file is empty. Direction: it can only add an amber, collapsed, hedged block.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: Fails when build() puts differently spelled suburbs under separate keys, when areas are not ordered by area_id, or when the shared file is not the exact output of the source file.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: The source file data/chapter_scope/suburb_unconfirmed_areas.json is the authority; the test builds a fixture with two spellings of one suburb and expects one grouped, ordered list.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Observed red: with the suburb normalisation and the area_id sort removed from build(), test_build_groups_by_council_and_normalised_suburb failed; restored, both tests pass.

pre_impl.existing_data: DcpNotCoveredNotice.tsx and export_not_covered_councils.py are the council-wide equivalents; nothing existed per suburb. The shared JSON is empty because the areas list is empty.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: localityOf in address-number-match.ts is not exported and that file may not be edited here, so suburbFromAddress rebuilds it from the exported parseStreet.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: New files only, mirroring the not-covered notice and its export script; pageLabel from lib/page-citation.ts is reused for the page text.

functions.name: DcpMayApplyBlock
functions.what: Renders one collapsed amber details per area with a hedged explanation and its rules.
functions.input: mayApply: array of areas, or null or undefined
functions.output: JSX, or null when there are no areas
functions.if_none: Returns null and renders nothing at all.
functions.edge_cases: Missing provisions array is treated as zero rules; singular rule wording for one.
functions.failure_mode: A missing reason_text leaves a gap in the sentence but never claims the property is inside the area.

functions.name: suburbFromAddress
functions.what: Reads the normalised suburb from an address with or without a comma.
functions.input: An address string, possibly empty or missing.
functions.output: uppercase suburb string or empty string
functions.if_none: Returns an empty string, so no suburb match is made.
functions.edge_cases: Unit prefixes, slash numbers, NSW and postcode removed.
functions.failure_mode: An unparseable address yields empty, so no suburb match and no block is shown.

functions.name: build
functions.what: Groups areas by council then normalised suburb, sorted by area_id.
functions.output: A nested dict of council, then suburb, then areas.
functions.if_none: Empty areas list gives an empty dict.
functions.edge_cases: Whitespace and case differences in suburb collapse to one key.
functions.failure_mode: A missing suburb or area_id key raises KeyError, visibly.

break_it.what_happens: The summary says zero rules, with explanation.
break_it.how: Renders the explanation with an empty list rather than crashing; covered by the optional-chain on provisions.

break_it.scenario: Suburb spelled differently in the source file.
break_it.what_happens: Area is filed under two keys and one is never matched.
break_it.how: build() uppercases and collapses spaces; the pytest fixture covers it.

break_it.scenario: A reason code arrives that is not in the map.
break_it.how: reasonText returns null for unknown and inherited keys such as toString; the component shows the reason_text it is given.

verified: tsc --noEmit reports no errors in the new files.
gaps: Jest was not run locally (no node_modules in the worktree); the two jest files are unexecuted.
Not wired into the route or the DCP tab; that change is in flight elsewhere.

post_merge.manual_verify: Once the route returns meta.may_apply, view an address in a listed suburb and confirm the block is collapsed and hedged.
